a_H6a_intersection_union.motivation: the per-codeword primary outcome z was defined against the POOLED 56-control family (46 RAND + 10 SHUF); the basket-vs-button contrast sign depended on which family z was computed against (log S-097/S-098), so a single pooled z is not a robust per-codeword outcome.
a_H6a_intersection_union.rule: For each confirmation codeword compute THREE r1 VALIDATION specificity z's: z_pooled (vs all 56 controls), z_RAND (vs the 46 random orthonormal rank-1 controls), z_SHUF (vs the 10 shuffled-label controls); z = (candidate recovery stat − mean family) / sd family, frozen analyzer statistic. H6a PASSES only if the one-sided permutation Spearman(held-out probe rho, z_f) has p < 0.05 for ALL THREE f (intersection-union test; no multiplicity correction needed across f). All three Spearman rho/p are reported, each also as a descriptive number; a pass on a subset of families is reported as 'family-dependent', never as a pass.

power.source: research/heretic_csi/p6_power_iut.py -> reports/heretic_csi/hcsi_p6_power_iut.json (reliability 0.7; c = fraction of outcome measurement noise shared across the three families, unknown a priori)
power.caveat: the model gives all three families equal reliability; z_SHUF rests on only 10 controls (noisier sd), so real IUT power is likely at or below the low-c rows.

a_H6a_intersection_union.UNDERPOWERED_rule_v4: H6a (IUT) is PRE-LABELLED 'UNDERPOWERED for rho < 0.8' if n_conf < 15 and 'CANNOT ANSWER' (no confirmation GPU spent; redesign) if n_conf < 12 — unchanged thresholds; note that even at n_conf = 15 IUT power at rho 0.7 is ~0.57–0.72, so a non-pass at rho < 0.8 may not be read as a null.

b_H6c: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Per codeword it reads r1 then r4 on VALIDATION; a per-codeword 'specific at rank r' call uses Holm over {1,4} WITHIN that codeword (frozen rank rule, 56 controls; floor 0.0175 — note Holm's first step needs p <= 0.025, attainable at rank 1/57). Minimal specific rank = 1 if r1 is Holm-specific, else 4 if r4 is, else '>4'. Never upgrades H6a.

c_declared_dependence.dependence: H6a's covariate (held-out probe quality: probe FIT on TRAIN, Spearman SCORED on the 23 VALIDATION domains) and its outcome z (r1 rescue specificity on the same 23 VALIDATION domains) share the VALIDATION domains/rows. Shared domain-level noise could induce or mask a covariate–outcome correlation across codewords. Declared, not removed.
c_declared_dependence.sensitivity: H6a (all three families, IUT) recomputed with probe quality scored on TRAIN leave-one-domain-out (fit on 66 TRAIN domains, predict the held-out TRAIN domain, Spearman over all 67 TRAIN domains; research/heretic_csi/p6_heldout_probe.py logic with TRAIN-LOO scoring) — disjoint from the VALIDATION outcome. If the TRAIN-LOO version flips the H6a decision, H6a is reported as 'DEPENDENCE-SENSITIVE'. The sensitivity never rescues a failed primary.
